text:
marta: Quick design check — new "Capacity headroom" control in the autoscale panel. Figma link: https://figma.com/file/placeholder. Thinking: single knob + numeric min/max + SLO slider. Thoughts on copy + a11y?

josh: Quick read — love the compact layout. One concern: people expect the word "burst"; "Headroom" might read oddly. Suggest: "Headroom (short-term burst)" as label. :thinking_face:

alex: +1. Also the numeric input needs clear keyboard affordances (stepper buttons) and the knob track contrast is too low — aim for 4.5:1 on track vs background. :mag:

alex: aria example for the numeric field:
```html
<input type="number" aria-label="Min capacity" aria-valuemin="1" aria-valuemax="64" aria-valuenow="4" />
```

sam: Cost preview note — when headroom is enabled/shrinks, show an inline estimate like: "approx +$0.12/hr when active". Also: if someone lowers min below current running capacity we should warn "May evict running jobs" and require a quick confirmation.

erin: Guardrail copy: the SLO slider should show a soft recommended range and a hard floor label. Tooltip draft: "SLO = latency target. Sliding left saves cost, sliding right reduces tail latency." Keep it short.

marta: UX nit — the info icon currently opens a modal; prefer an inline popover (less context switch). Also add aria-describedby from the slider to the help text so screen readers get the association.

josh: Agree on popover. For narrow screens/mobile, make the knob larger for hit-target and hide the slider ticks. :iphone:

sam: Another idea: if headroom >> baseline, surface a tiny visualization "headroom vs baseline" (sparkline) so users see potential churn.

deploy-bot: Build deployed to staging: https://staging.redwood/feat/capacity-headroom (build #482) :package:

erin: Accessibility checklist to cover before merge: keyboard focus states, focus trap in popover, announce value changes via aria-live, meaningful labels for +/- steppers.

marta: Thanks all — I'll update the Figma copy to "Headroom (short-term burst)", swap modal -> popover, add inline cost estimate and confirmation when lowering min. Will share new frames for a quick pass. :raised_hands:
